title.zh: CFTC提出将体育等事件合约纳入掉期定义并发布临时最终规则
title.en: CFTC Proposes CTX and CAM Rules to Establish Federal Crypto Exchange Framework

current_state.zh:
上周，包括前参议员 Chris Dodd、前 CFTC 与 SEC 主席 Gary Gensler、美国职业橄榄球大联盟（NFL）、39 个州及哥伦比亚特区以及 145 个部落民族在内的一批相关方提交了法庭之友意见书，敦促美国最高法院受理“以体育为基础的预测市场合约是否属于互换（swap）”这一问题。上周五，CFTC 就同一问题发布了两项方案，其中一项为已即刻生效的临时最终规则。

目前上诉法院之间已出现重大分歧：两个上诉法院裁定涉及体育的预测市场属于博彩产品、应由各州监管，而另一个上诉法院则裁定这属于 CFTC 的管辖范围。

Dodd 的意见书主张，《多德-弗兰克法案》的立法本意并非赋予 CFTC 取代各州博彩监管的权力，并指出将多个投注串联起来的“串关”（parlay）并不具有对冲或价格发现功能，因此不属于《商品交易法》下的互换；他还反驳了 CFTC 所获“专属管辖权”构成明确优先适用（preemption）条款的说法。据 CFTC 称，该临时最终规则将其长期立场成文化，即包括体育博彩和赌场投注在内的赌场式博彩产品被排除在“互换”定义之外，而另一项提案则将进一步把事件合约纳入互换的定义。
current_state.en: A coalition including former officials, the NFL, 39 states and 145 tribal nations filed amicus briefs urging the Supreme Court to weigh in on whether sports-based prediction market contracts are swaps, while the CFTC issued two proposals — one an interim final rule already in effect — setting out its own position on the question.

updates.title_zh: 华盛顿全力拥抱加密：特朗普、SEC、CFTC齐推新规
updates.title_en: Washington Goes All-In on Crypto: Trump, SEC, CFTC Advance New Rules
updates.what_changed_zh: 华盛顿全力拥抱加密：特朗普、SEC、CFTC齐推新规
updates.what_changed_en: Washington Goes All-In on Crypto: Trump, SEC, CFTC Advance New Rules
updates.current_state_zh: 华盛顿全力拥抱加密：特朗普、SEC、CFTC齐推新规
updates.current_state_en: Washington Goes All-In on Crypto: Trump, SEC, CFTC Advance New Rules
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 本周，SEC首次推出针对加密资产的规则提案“Regulation Crypto Assets”，允许特定项目在四年内募资不超过500万美元或每年不超过7500万美元而无需完全注册。特朗普总统在白宫会见加密行业高管，敦促国会通过“公平版本”的Clarity Act；CFTC主席Mike Selig则启动创新咨询委员会，并警告若法案受阻，CFTC将利用现有权力自行建立加密监管框架。 这标志着美国加密政策从“以执法为主导”转向SEC和CFTC的正式规则制定，并获得白宫支持。若这些提案落地，将实质性改变数字资产在美国的发行与交易方式，影响发行方、交易所和投资者。 SEC提案包含一个有条件的“安全港”条款：当发行方的关键管理努力结束后，相关加密资产可获豁免；同时该提案将优先于部分州的证券注册要求。该提案在预定投票被突然取消几天后正式发布；CFTC主席Selig已指示工作人员研究加密资产规则。
updates.detailed_summary_en: This week, the SEC proposed its first crypto-specific rulemaking, Regulation Crypto Assets, allowing certain offerings of up to $5 million over four years or $75 million annually without full registration. President Trump hosted crypto executives at the White House and pressed Congress to pass a "fair version" of the Clarity Act, while CFTC Chairman Mike Selig launched the Innovation Advisory Committee and warned that the CFTC would use existing authorities to build its own crypto regime if the Act stalls. This marks a coordinated shift in U.S. crypto policy from enforcement toward formal rulemaking across both the SEC and CFTC, with White House backing. If enacted, these proposals could materially reshape how digital assets are issued and traded in the U.S., affecting issuers, exchanges, and investors. The SEC proposal includes a conditional safe harbor for crypto assets once an issuer's essential managerial efforts have ended, and it would preempt certain state securities registration requirements. The proposal was formally issued days after the scheduled vote was abruptly cancelled, and CFTC Chairman Selig has already directed staff to explore crypto-asset rules.

updates.title_zh: 晨间速览：CFTC 公布监管加密交易所的计划
updates.title_en: Morning Minute: The CFTC Reveals Plan to Regulate Crypto Exchanges
updates.what_changed_zh:
CFTC 公布了一份初步提案，拟通过两项新规——Regulation CTX 与 Regulation CAM——建立加密交易所的联邦许可框架，文件在《联邦公报》刊登后将开启为期 60 天的公众意见征询期。此时距《Clarity 法案》在参议院夭折已有三周，同日 SEC 还批准了 3 倍杠杆的 BTC 和 ETH 基金上市交易。

该计划提出了单一的联邦许可选择，并以是否涉及杠杆来决定谁需要持牌，这是国会未能通过的框架，将允许美国交易平台提供目前无法提供的保证金类产品。不过这是一份征求意见的初步概念文件，并非具有约束力的规则文本。

牌照将覆盖撮合买卖双方、托管客户资金与加密资产、结算交易以及借贷，每项业务需分别获批；交易将通过已受反洗钱规则约束的经纪商进行，且只有这些经纪商或其保荐银行可以提供杠杆。该机构还在考虑储备金证明要求，以及针对易被操纵代币的上市标准；CFTC 主席 Mike Selig 表示，这些规则的目的是防止类似 FTX 的欺诈，而非事后追诉。
updates.what_changed_en: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.

updates.background_zh: 参议院未能达到推进《CLARITY 法案》所需的 60 票门槛，该法案本将为数字资产建立法定框架。美国加密交易目前要么适用为其他市场制定的规则，要么适用各州不一的地方牌照。CFTC 的这份通知还否定了该机构在拜登时期对 Kraken、Ooki DAO 和 Uniswap 的执法案件，称其为“以执法代替监管”。
updates.background_en: The Senate failed to reach the 60 votes needed to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have created a statutory framework for digital assets. Crypto trading in the US currently runs under rules built for other markets or under state licenses that vary by state. The CFTC notice also disowns the agency's Biden-era cases against Kraken, Ooki DAO and Uniswap as regulation by enforcement.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于美国市场准入：联邦牌照将使本土交易所能够上线目前主要在离岸提供的杠杆及永续类产品，涉及交易所股票、在岸永续合约场所及为其撮合交易的经纪商，而更清晰的规则也会降低银行和券商涉足加密业务的门槛。由于该文件只是开启意见征询期，近期影响限于围绕美国受监管场所的情绪与仓位，而非已生效的规则。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through US market access: a federal license would let domestic exchanges list leveraged and perpetual-style products now largely offered offshore, putting exchange equities, listed perp venues and the brokers routing those trades in scope, with clear rules also lowering the barrier for banks and brokers to touch crypto. Because the document only opens a comment period, near-term effects are confined to sentiment and positioning around US-regulated venues rather than to rules in force.

updates.title_zh: 【NFL 支持各州监管预测市场体育合约，反对 CFTC 独占管辖权】
updates.title_en: 【NFL 支持各州监管预测市场体育合约，反对 CFTC 独占管辖权】
updates.what_changed_zh: NFL向最高法院提交法庭意见书，支持新泽西州在Kalshi案中的调卷令申请，主张各州可对预测市场的体育事件合约施加赌博监管，并对CFTC声称拥有专属联邦管辖权提出异议，指出Kalshi未遵守操纵防范措施、内部人员投注限制和21岁年龄要求。
updates.what_changed_en: The NFL filed an amicus brief with the Supreme Court supporting New Jersey's cert petition in the Kalshi case, arguing states may impose gambling regulation on prediction-market sports event contracts and disputing the CFTC's claim of exclusive federal jurisdiction, citing unmet manipulation safeguards, insider-betting limits, and age-21 requirements that Kalshi does not follow.

updates.title_zh: 美CFTC拟将预测市场事件合约纳入掉期监管，争夺联邦监管权
updates.title_en: 美CFTC拟将预测市场事件合约纳入掉期监管，争夺联邦监管权
updates.what_changed_zh: CFTC发布了一项立即生效的临时最终规则，并提出另一项新规，拟将Kalshi和Polymarket等平台的预测市场事件合约纳入其掉期监管框架；临时最终规则已立即生效但仍接受公众意见，新规提案则有30天意见征询期。
updates.what_changed_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework; the interim final rule is effective immediately but remains open to comment, while the proposed rule has a 30-day comment period.
updates.current_state_zh: CFTC已发布立即生效的临时最终规则及一项新规提案，将预测市场事件合约纳入掉期监管框架，从而升级与各州之间的管辖权争端。
updates.current_state_en: The CFTC has issued an immediately effective interim final rule and a proposed rule to bring prediction-market event contracts under its swaps regulatory framework, escalating its jurisdiction dispute with states.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework, escalating its federal jurisdiction fight with states.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework, escalating its federal jurisdiction fight with states.

updates.title_zh: CFTC提议区分预测合约与体育博彩投注
updates.title_en: CFTC proposes a divide between prediction contracts and sportsbook wagers
updates.what_changed_zh: CFTC提案明确将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，进一步划定预测市场与赌博的联邦界限。
updates.what_changed_en: The CFTC proposed expressly including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, further drawing the federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
updates.current_state_zh: CFTC已提出规则将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布立即生效的临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，意见征询期分别为30天，持续与各州管辖权冲突。
updates.current_state_en: The CFTC has proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an immediately effective interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, each with a 30-day comment period, continuing its jurisdiction conflict with states.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The CFTC proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition while issuing an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, drawing a federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The CFTC proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition while issuing an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, drawing a federal line between prediction markets and gambling.

updates.title_zh: 各方都希望最高法院受理预测市场案：State of Crypto
updates.title_en: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
updates.what_changed_zh:
上周，包括前参议员 Chris Dodd、前 CFTC 与 SEC 主席 Gary Gensler、美国职业橄榄球大联盟（NFL）、39 个州及哥伦比亚特区以及 145 个部落民族在内的一批相关方提交了法庭之友意见书，敦促美国最高法院受理“以体育为基础的预测市场合约是否属于互换（swap）”这一问题。上周五，CFTC 就同一问题发布了两项方案，其中一项为已即刻生效的临时最终规则。

目前上诉法院之间已出现重大分歧：两个上诉法院裁定涉及体育的预测市场属于博彩产品、应由各州监管，而另一个上诉法院则裁定这属于 CFTC 的管辖范围。

Dodd 的意见书主张，《多德-弗兰克法案》的立法本意并非赋予 CFTC 取代各州博彩监管的权力，并指出将多个投注串联起来的“串关”（parlay）并不具有对冲或价格发现功能，因此不属于《商品交易法》下的互换；他还反驳了 CFTC 所获“专属管辖权”构成明确优先适用（preemption）条款的说法。据 CFTC 称，该临时最终规则将其长期立场成文化，即包括体育博彩和赌场投注在内的赌场式博彩产品被排除在“互换”定义之外，而另一项提案则将进一步把事件合约纳入互换的定义。
updates.what_changed_en: A coalition including former officials, the NFL, 39 states and 145 tribal nations filed amicus briefs urging the Supreme Court to weigh in on whether sports-based prediction market contracts are swaps, while the CFTC issued two proposals — one an interim final rule already in effect — setting out its own position on the question.
updates.current_state_zh:
上周，包括前参议员 Chris Dodd、前 CFTC 与 SEC 主席 Gary Gensler、美国职业橄榄球大联盟（NFL）、39 个州及哥伦比亚特区以及 145 个部落民族在内的一批相关方提交了法庭之友意见书，敦促美国最高法院受理“以体育为基础的预测市场合约是否属于互换（swap）”这一问题。上周五，CFTC 就同一问题发布了两项方案，其中一项为已即刻生效的临时最终规则。

目前上诉法院之间已出现重大分歧：两个上诉法院裁定涉及体育的预测市场属于博彩产品、应由各州监管，而另一个上诉法院则裁定这属于 CFTC 的管辖范围。

Dodd 的意见书主张，《多德-弗兰克法案》的立法本意并非赋予 CFTC 取代各州博彩监管的权力，并指出将多个投注串联起来的“串关”（parlay）并不具有对冲或价格发现功能，因此不属于《商品交易法》下的互换；他还反驳了 CFTC 所获“专属管辖权”构成明确优先适用（preemption）条款的说法。据 CFTC 称，该临时最终规则将其长期立场成文化，即包括体育博彩和赌场投注在内的赌场式博彩产品被排除在“互换”定义之外，而另一项提案则将进一步把事件合约纳入互换的定义。

updates.detailed_summary_en: A coalition including former officials, the NFL, 39 states and 145 tribal nations filed amicus briefs urging the Supreme Court to weigh in on whether sports-based prediction market contracts are swaps, while the CFTC issued two proposals — one an interim final rule already in effect — setting out its own position on the question.
updates.background_zh: 2010 年《多德-弗兰克华尔街改革与消费者保护法案》是这场围绕 CFTC 权限之争的核心法律。预测市场服务商持有 CFTC 颁发的指定合约市场（DCM）牌照。法庭之友意见书是由非案件正式当事方提交的倡导性文件；最高法院每年收到数千份调卷令申请，但仅受理其中很小一部分。在正式发布之前，CFTC 已将这两项预测市场规则制定案送交白宫信息与监管事务办公室（OIRA）审查。
updates.background_en: The 2010 Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act is the law at the center of the argument over the CFTC's authority here. Prediction market providers operate under designated contract market (DCM) licenses issued by the CFTC. An amicus brief is an advocacy filing by a party that is not formally part of the case; the Supreme Court receives thousands of certiorari petitions a year but grants review in only a small fraction. The CFTC had sent both prediction-market rulemakings to the White House Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs for review before they were issued.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这场争议决定的是由 CFTC 还是由各州来制定体育类事件合约的上架与准入规则，因此直接承受监管风险的是预测市场平台以及其他提供事件合约的场所，包括与加密相关的衍生品交易场所。临时最终规则将赌场式博彩产品排除在互换定义之外，而配套提案又拟将事件合约纳入互换定义，这改变了上述场所所适用的合规基准。
updates.market_impact_en: The dispute determines which regulator — the CFTC or individual states — sets the listing and access rules for sports-based event contracts, so prediction-market platforms and other venues offering event contracts, including crypto-adjacent derivatives venues, carry the direct regulatory exposure. The interim final rule's exclusion of casino-style gambling products from the swap definition, and the companion proposal to define swaps to include event contracts, change the compliance baseline those venues operate under.
